title: Python: the blind-sample freeze and pre-registration ((a36) item 8; step 6 folded in)
description: Filed record-only under opum-doc's ruling ODOC-640 (opum-ai/opum-doc#2065). DEC-303 (a36) item 8. Step 6 was the fresh-sample PROPOSAL and was already ruled in (a36), so there is no step-6 task; its remainder folds in here: the two replacement repositories for werkzeug and starlette, measured by script over the text WITHOUT glyph ((a36) items 2 and 7). This task holds the freeze and the pre-registration commit. The draw stays HELD until the hold list has landed and opum-doc has read step 5; the GO comes from opum-doc. No clone of a sample repository before then ((a36) item 1).
